decision_conditions: Enlargement of a dwelling house (Class A) - The erection of a single storey rear extension and replacement of first floor rear window would consist of the enlargement of a dwelling house within the meaning of Class A of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Town & Country Planning (General Permitted Development)  (England) Order 2015 "the Order" and would comply with the development tolerances set out in said Class A. The operation would therefore have been granted planning permission by Article 3 of the Order.

Enlargement of a dwelling house (Class B) - The erection of a rear dormer roof extension and replacement roof tiles would consist of the enlargement of a dwelling house within the meaning of Class B of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Town & Country Planning (General Permitted Development)  (England) Order 2015 "the Order" and would comply with the development tolerances set out in said Class B. The operation would therefore have been granted planning permission by Article 3 of the Order.

Alteration to the roof of the dwelling house (Class C) - The insertion of x2 rooflights to front roofslope would consist of any other alteration to the roof of the dwelling house within the meaning of Class C of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Town & Country Planning (General Permitted Development)  (England) Order 2015 "the Order" and would comply with the development tolerances set out in said Class C. The operation would therefore have been granted planning permission by Article 3 of the Order.
description: APPLICATION FOR A LAWFUL DEVELOPMENT CERTIFICATE IN RESPECT OF THE PROPOSED ERECTION OF A REAR DORMER ROOF EXTENSION, INSERTION OF X2 ROOFLIGHTS TO FRONT ROOFSLOPE, RPELACEMENT ROOF TILES AND FIRST FLOOR REAR WINDOW AND DEMOLITION OF EXISTING OUTBUILDING AND ERECTION OF A SINGLE STOREY REAR EXTENSION
